reviewItem.question: For "L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will not load the key `ca.crt` even if it is present in the secret", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether environment uses L7 network policies with terminatingTLS that rely on ca.crt loading

proposed.statement: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from secrets by default; set --use-full-tls-context=true to restore the old behavior.
